verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure: the GLACIER wordmark, a one-line headline, the subhead, the pills in order and the legal line all survive. Its flaws are that the CTA is jammed right against the end of the subhead, it overlaps the lower decorative circle, and the bottom-right is a bit empty. B shrinks the GLACIER logo into a tiny label inside the circle, wraps the headline onto two lines, and makes the CTA oversized and pill-shaped so it competes with the headline. The flavour pills are stacked in reverse order and squeezed in beside the CTA, the legal text is wedged into the right edge over a circle, and the bottom row is crowded with competing focal points.
